name: scribe
description: Professional documentation structure, writing, and technical visual skills with one guided entry point.

interface.shortDescription: Structure and write clear professional documents.
interface.longDescription: Plan general and domain-specific documentation structures, then create domain knowledge sets, essence articles, knowledge documents, PRDs, architecture records, decisions, and technical diagrams through focused, composable skills.
defaultPrompt: Use Ask Scribe to explain which Scribe skills fit my task and how to combine them.

Use Write Domain Doc to write a first-principles essence article for this domain.

Turn this architecture into a concise diagram.
